originality.rationale: 2023 cycle-space projection work establishes the ambient Banach-space framework but not this fan family. Earlier full fan resistance tables provide Green-kernel entries, not the evaluation and comparison of absolute-current operator norms. The new claim analytically classifies the maximizing edge type for both complementary projections and identifies an exact parity-swapped Fibonacci–Lucas gap on every fan. Searches found no covering statement, with a specific residual risk from pre-existing explicit resistance matrices and inaccessible older full text.

value.rationale: A natural maximal outerplanar two-tree family exhibits an exact parity reversal in which of two complementary Banach-space Hodge projection norms dominates; the gap is a nonzero Fibonacci quotient decaying exponentially, and the norm maximizers lie in opposite geometric edge types. The theorem classifies all sizes rather than reporting a few graph evaluations. Known resistance formulas alone do not identify these operator-norm extremizers.
